stories.head: A real Key Largo home that looks like Jason's GTA 6 house is up for sale
stories.say: Three gaming stories you missed. Number one: a real-life Key Largo house that looks just like Jason's GTA 6 home is up for sale, for nearly seven hundred fifty thousand dollars. And yes, it has a boat in the yard too!

stories.head: Witcher 3 Remastered patch 5.02: 40 cross-platform mods, bald-Geralt bug fixed
stories.say: Number two: The Witcher 3 Remastered's patch five point oh two adds forty cross-platform mods, and fixes bugs that turned Geralt bald and made time go backwards.

stories.head: Marvelous seeks 65 voluntary early retirements after a 1,105% profit jump
stories.say: And number three: Marvelous, the Story of Seasons studio, wants to cut sixty-five jobs through voluntary early retirement, in the same year its profit jumped one thousand one hundred five percent.
